description: Reviewed derivation of CVSS v4.0 base metric values from recorded facts. Each metric reads one fact; a fact value with a case below yields that metric value with the stated basis and rationale. A fact that is absent, or a value with no case, leaves the metric MISSING and the assessment incomplete (no score). 'assumption' cases are documented defaults that are listed on the assessment; they are never silent.

unauthenticated.rationale: The affected entry point is an HTTP route served over the network.

authenticated.rationale: The affected entry point is an HTTP route served over the network; authentication is scored by PR, not AV.

confirmed.rationale: A fixed, parameterised check reproduced the behaviour without defeating any mitigation.

none_recorded.rationale: The attack path records no deployment or execution preconditions; a human should confirm none exist in production.

recorded.rationale: The attack path lists preconditions that must hold (token, knowledge of an identifier); Attack Requirements are Present.

low.rationale: The check succeeded as an ordinary authenticated fixture identity.

high.rationale: The check required an administrative fixture identity.

direct_request.rationale: The check template issues requests as the attacking identity only; no other user takes part.

access_control.ownership|financial.rationale: Another identity's financial records were returned; restricted data of an arbitrary owner is disclosed.

access_control.ownership|personal.rationale: Another identity's personal records were returned; restricted data of an arbitrary owner is disclosed.

access_control.ownership|internal.rationale: Internal, non-sensitive records of another identity were returned.

input_validation.bounds|financial.rationale: The bounds check only creates the caller's own records; nothing belonging to others is read.

input_validation.bounds|personal.rationale: The bounds check only creates the caller's own records; nothing belonging to others is read.

access_control.ownership.rationale: The ownership check is read-only; an integrity effect was not exercised and is not claimed.

input_validation.bounds.rationale: The check pushed an accumulated total past its documented bound: data the system relies on was modified beyond policy, within the caller's own records.

not_exercised.rationale: No system beyond the vulnerable application was in scope of the executed check.
